stem.text: A toy motorboat moving with constant velocity $v$ vibrates up and down on the surface of a pond. This causes the boat to act as a source of circular water waves of frequency $2.0\,\text{Hz}$. The speed of the waves is $1.5\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
A man, standing at the edge of the pond, observes that the waves from the boat approach him with a frequency of $3.0\,\text{Hz}$.
The formula for Doppler effect calculations with sound waves may also be used for water waves.
What is a possible value of $v$?
